Sends requests with various role cookie values (Admin=true, roleid=2, etc.) and checks for privilege escalation. Also tests JSON body field manipulation for profile update endpoints.

Returns: {"baseline": dict, "results": [{"value": str, "status": int, "length": int, "escalated": bool}], "escalation_candidates": [str]}.

Side effects: If json_body is set, sends POST/PUT requests that may modify state.

url.description: Protected URL to access, e.g. https://target/admin or https://target/api/users

json_body.description: JSON body for POST-based role escalation, e.g. '{"roleid":2}'. Will test each value substituted

json_field.description: JSON field to manipulate in json_body, e.g. 'roleid'

cookie_name.description: Cookie name for role control, e.g. 'admin', 'role', 'is_admin'

extra_cookies.description: Additional cookies to include, e.g. 'session=abc123; logged_in=true'

parameters.name: cookie_name
parameters.description: Cookie name for role control, e.g. 'admin', 'role', 'is_admin'

parameters.name: cookie_values
parameters.description: Values to test, e.g. ['true','1','admin','2','yes']

parameters.name: extra_cookies
parameters.description: Additional cookies to include, e.g. 'session=abc123; logged_in=true'

parameters.name: json_body
parameters.description: JSON body for POST-based role escalation, e.g. '{"roleid":2}'. Will test each value substituted

parameters.name: json_field
parameters.description: JSON field to manipulate in json_body, e.g. 'roleid'

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Protected URL to access, e.g. https://target/admin or https://target/api/users

tool_signatures.name: sqli_blind_boolean
tool_signatures.description: Boolean-based blind SQLi with binary search character enumeration. Uses ASCII(SUBSTRING(...))>N technique with binary search for efficiency. Determines true/false by comparing response lengths. Returns extracted_value, characters_found, requests_sent. Side effects: Read-only. Sends ~8 requests per character (binary search on ASCII 32-126).

url.description: Full URL with injectable parameter

query.description: SQL sub-query to extract, e.g. 'database()' or '(SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1)'

parameters.name: max_length
parameters.description: Maximum string length to extract

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description: Vulnerable parameter name

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: SQL sub-query to extract, e.g. 'database()' or '(SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1)'

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Full URL with injectable parameter

tool_signatures.name: sqli_blind_time
tool_signatures.description: Time-based blind SQLi detection for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MSSQL. Sends sleep-inducing payloads and measures response time to detect injection. Returns vulnerable, dbtype, and results array with payload, response_time, triggered. Side effects: Read-only but slow (each payload waits up to delay_seconds). Sends 3 requests.

url.description: Full URL with injectable parameter

parameters.name: dbtype
parameters.description: Target database type

parameters.name: delay_seconds
parameters.description: Sleep duration for true condition

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description: Vulnerable parameter name

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Full URL with injectable parameter

tool_signatures.name: sqli_file_read
tool_signatures.description: Read server files via UNION SELECT LOAD_FILE(). Requires MySQL FILE privilege. Uses LOAD_FILE() in a UNION SELECT. Returns file_content, success, target_file. Errors: FILE privilege required. Returns empty if privilege denied.

url.description: Full URL with injectable parameter

column_count.description: Number of columns (from previous UNION discovery)

parameters.name: column_count
parameters.description: Number of columns (from previous UNION discovery)

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description: Vulnerable parameter name

parameters.name: string_column
parameters.description: 1-indexed column that displays strings

parameters.name: target_file
parameters.description: Server-side file to read, e.g. /etc/passwd

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Full URL with injectable parameter

tool_signatures.name: sqli_login_bypass
tool_signatures.description: Bypass login via SQL comment truncation (administrator'--). Extracts CSRF token from form, then POSTs with SQLi in the username field. The -- comment truncates the password check. Returns csrf_extracted, status_code, response_length, headers, likely_bypass.

url.description: Login form URL, e.g. https://target/login

username.description: Target username to bypass auth for, e.g. 'administrator'

csrf_field.description: Name of the CSRF token field in the form

password_field.description: Name of the password form field

username_field.description: Name of the username form field

parameters.description: Name of the CSRF token field in the form

parameters.name: password_field
parameters.description: Name of the password form field

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Login form URL, e.g. https://target/login

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Target username to bypass auth for, e.g. 'administrator'

parameters.name: username_field
parameters.description: Name of the username form field

tool_signatures.name: sqli_union_extract
tool_signatures.description: Step-by-step UNION-based data extraction. 1. Finds column count via ORDER BY. 2. Identifies string-displayable columns via UNION SELECT. 3. Extracts database name and version. 4. Lists tables and columns. Returns column_count, string_columns, db_name, db_version, tables, user_columns. Side effects: Read-only GET requests. Sends ~30 requests depending on column count.

url.description: Full URL with injectable parameter, e.g. https://target/filter?category=Gifts

max_columns.description: Maximum columns to probe with ORDER BY

parameters.name: max_columns
parameters.description: Maximum columns to probe with ORDER BY

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description: Vulnerable query parameter name

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Full URL with injectable parameter, e.g. https://target/filter?category=Gifts

tool_signatures.name: sqli_where_bypass
tool_signatures.description: Test WHERE clause bypass via OR 1=1 variants. Sends multiple payloads (OR 1=1--, OR '1'='1, OR 1=1/*, etc.) against the target parameter and compares response lengths to the baseline. Returns baseline_length and results array. Side effects: None (read-only GET requests). Sends 7 requests total.

url.description: Full URL with query parameter, e.g. https://target/filter?category=Gifts

value.description: Legitimate parameter value to base the injection on, e.g. 'Gifts'

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description: Vulnerable query parameter name, e.g. 'category'

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Full URL with query parameter, e.g. https://target/filter?category=Gifts

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Legitimate parameter value to base the injection on, e.g. 'Gifts'

tool_signatures.name: ssrf_test
tool_signatures.description: Test SSRF with localhost bypass variants. Sends 10+ representations of localhost (127.0.0.1, 0, decimal, hex, IPv6, etc.) to check if the server fetches internal resources. tool_signatures.name: xss_reflected_test
tool_signatures.description: Test multiple reflected XSS vectors against a parameter. Sends 10 payloads (script tags, event handlers, SVG, attribute injection, case variation, template literals) and checks if they appear unescaped in the response. Returns results array with reflected/encoded/status per payload, and vulnerable_count. Side effects: Read-only GET requests. Sends 10 requests.

url.description: URL with reflectable parameter, e.g. https://target/search?q=test

parameter.description: Parameter name that reflects input, e.g. 'q'

parameters.description: Parameter name that reflects input, e.g. 'q'
